q: Interest on capital is:

options.D: An expense debited to P&L and credited to capital

e: The correct answer is An expense debited to the Profit and Loss Account and added to capital. The trading and profit & loss account arrives at gross and net results by matching revenues with the costs of the period. Remember: Link this to the connected chapter topic; cross-topic twists are common in this exam. Watch the timeline or sequence in such questions; many errors come from mixing up the order.
